name: FAdam
description: Compact Adam-style optimizer with bias-corrected first and second gradient moments.

examples.title: Minimize a scalar objective with FAdam
examples.code:
import torch
from topologies.implementations.optimizers.fadam import fadam

parameter = torch.nn.Parameter(torch.tensor(3.0))
optimizer = fadam([parameter], lr=0.05)
for _ in range(20):
    optimizer.zero_grad()
    (parameter - 1).square().backward()
    optimizer.step()
